seo.title: Austin Homeless Help - No Home Help
seo.description: Verified practical resources for people experiencing homelessness in Austin.

page.heading: AUSTIN - HOMELESS HELP
page.urgent: Immediate danger: 911. Shelter navigation: 512-522-1097. Local information: 211. Crisis support: call or text 988.
page.notice: Availability, eligibility, hours, and capacity can change. Call ahead when possible. A listing does not guarantee a bed, meal, appointment, benefit, job, or legal representation.
page.intro: Call Sunrise Homeless Navigation Center at 512-522-1097 for shelter navigation. The Marshalling Yard does not accept walk-ins.
page.footer: Information can change. Call ahead when possible and report incorrect information through the GitHub link in the footer.

entries.title: Emergency services — 911
entries.description: For immediate danger, fire, a life-threatening medical emergency, or violence.
entries.how_to_access: Give the exact location and explain what is happening.

entries.title: Sunrise Homeless Navigation Center phone line
entries.description: Navigation for shelter and other resources; a call does not guarantee a bed.
entries.how_to_access: Explain your location, household, and urgent needs.

entries.title: City of Austin shelter information
entries.description: Official access guidance. Capacity, eligibility, and referral rules vary; the Marshalling Yard is referral-only.
entries.how_to_access: Call Sunrise and ask which current option fits your situation.

entries.title: Austin Resource Center for the Homeless (ARCH)
entries.description: Downtown shelter and service center. Bed availability and eligible groups can change.
entries.how_to_access: Call or ask Sunrise before traveling.

entries.title: Sunrise — food and basic needs
entries.description: Day services can include food and connections to other help. Daily availability varies.
entries.how_to_access: Call or visit during posted hours.

entries.title: Sunrise — showers and laundry
entries.description: Day services can include showers, laundry, restrooms, and hygiene supplies. Capacity varies.
entries.how_to_access: Arrive early and ask about sign-up.

entries.title: Austin homelessness health resources
entries.description: Official city links to medical, mental-health, and substance-use services.
entries.how_to_access: Use the city links or ask Sunrise for the closest clinic.

entries.title: Sunrise Homeless Navigation Center
entries.description: Low-barrier day center with navigation and basic-needs services.
entries.how_to_access: Walk in during current service hours.

entries.title: Sunrise — charging and internet
entries.description: May provide phone charging, computer or internet access, and navigation.

entries.title: Austin Public Health Neighborhood Centers
entries.description: Free help with food access, benefits, job search, screenings, and limited emergency assistance.
entries.how_to_access: Find and call the closest center.

entries.title: Your Texas Benefits
entries.description: Apply for SNAP, Medicaid, TANF, and other Texas benefits.
entries.how_to_access: Call 211 or apply online; approval depends on eligibility.

entries.title: Goodwill Central Texas job services
entries.description: Career coaching, job-search help, and training programs.
entries.how_to_access: Find a career center and confirm hours.

entries.title: Texas RioGrande Legal Aid
entries.description: Free civil legal help for eligible low-income people; acceptance depends on issue and capacity.

entries.title: SAFE Austin
entries.description: Confidential support for domestic violence, sexual assault, child abuse, and trafficking.
entries.how_to_access: Call when safe; call 911 for immediate danger.

entries.title: National Call Center for Homeless Veterans
entries.description: Connects veterans who are homeless or at risk with VA services and local resources.
entries.how_to_access: Call and say you are a veteran who is homeless or at risk of losing housing.
